name: pair-bridge
description: Use local models through PAIR with structured output, batch jobs, embeddings, vision, and concurrency across configured PCs.

interface.shortDescription: Use structured, batch and multimodal local model tools.
interface.longDescription: Inspect model capabilities and output budgets, validate structured answers, start process-local batches, and use loaded models for embeddings and vision.
defaultPrompt: Use pair_devices and pair_list to inspect installed local models.
Use pair_smart_ask for a bounded task with an installed model.
Use pair_capabilities, then start pair_job_start on different PCs before polling pair_job_status.
